noRole.title: No access yet
noRole.body: You are signed in as {email}, but the administrator has not given this account a role. Ask them to add you.
noRole.claimBody: This project has no administrator yet. If you set it up, make yourself the first admin. This button disappears once an admin exists.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: Your role ({role}) does not include this screen.

home.subtitle: Inventory and sales at a glance.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: Receive deliveries, move stock between locations, and count the display and storage locations.
stock.readOnly: You can view stock. Only admins and warehouse staff can change it.
stock.empty: No products are currently marked for sale.
stock.receiveAllocationError: Enter a valid total and make sure display + storage equals the total.
stock.returnDestination: Destination: warehouse (warehouse quantities are not shown here).

inventory.title: Inventory count
inventory.intro: Count display and storage only. Products with no visible stock are hidden.
inventory.invalidCount: Select a product and enter a valid quantity.
inventory.empty: No products have stock in display or storage.

sales.title: Sales history
sales.confirmCancel: Cancel receipt {receipt} and return its items to the selling location?

maintenance.title: Admin maintenance
maintenance.body: This permanently removes all imported products, stock movements, sales, customers and receipt history. Staff accounts remain.
maintenance.confirm: Start over and permanently delete the catalog and all related history?
maintenance.done: Deleted {count} products and all related history.

products.title: Products
products.emptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Import your price list from Import / Export, or add a product.
products.readOnly: You can view the catalog. Only an admin can change it.
products.deleteBody: {name} will be hidden from the catalog and the sale screen. Its history is kept and you can restore it later.

form.name: Name
form.wirelessHint: Leave empty when there is no separate wireless price.
form.barcodeTaken: This barcode belongs to another product.
form.badNumber: Enter a valid number (0 or more).
form.derivedFromRate: Calculated from USD × {rate}. Change the exchange rate to update all SYP prices.

products.exchangeRatePrompt: Enter SYP per USD exchange rate:
products.clearConfirm: This permanently deletes all products, stock movements, sales and customers. Continue?
products.clearDone: Cleared {count} products and all related history.

import.title: Import / Export
import.adminOnly: Import and export are for admins only.
import.chooseHint: Accepts the price-list extraction format or the simple template. The format is detected automatically. Nothing is saved until you press Import.
import.warningsCount: {count} rows have warnings. They will still be imported — please check them.
import.medianRatio: Typical SYP per USD in this file: {ratio}

errors.empty_file: The file has no data rows.
errors.unknown_format: Unrecognized columns. The first row must contain either "item_code" (template) or "Item_Code_or_Name" (price-list extraction).

issue.barcode_mangled: Barcode "{text}" was damaged by a spreadsheet (scientific notation) — barcode ignored
issue.ratio: Odd {tier} price ratio: {ratio} SYP/USD is {pct}% from the typical {median}
issue.wireless_higher: Wireless price {wireless} is higher than general price {general} ({currency})
issue.no_standalone_price: {field}: "{text}" is not a price — no standalone price
issue.inactive_match: Matches a deleted product — it will be updated but stays deleted

setup.title: Connect to your database
setup.intro: This site has not been connected to Supabase yet. Paste the two values from Supabase → Project Settings → API. They are saved in this browser only.
setup.keyHint: The PUBLIC key (anon or publishable). Never paste the secret / service_role key.

problem.bad_url: That is not a valid https address.
problem.secret_key: That is a SECRET key. Do not use it here: it bypasses all security. Use the anon / publishable key instead.
